name: cavemio-subscription
title: Subscription
description: A billing page in one card: the plan with a ring through its billing period, usage, card and invoices, and a cancel that offers a pause first.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The status is a status region, so a pause or a cancel is announced once; usage bars are meters with their numbers.
- The pause offer and the reasons are labelled groups that take focus when the surface turns to them; Keep my plan goes back.
- Dates are written once mounted, in the visitor’s zone, so the server render never disagrees.
- Its light comes from your theme: the plan card mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, the ring and its ticks are 3px and thin line strokes in the same light, and an ending plan drains some colour. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Segmented control, Textarea, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion the faces change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: plan
props.description: – · The plan on the lit card.

props.name: status
props.description: – · Sets the status line and which actions show.

props.name: periodStart / periodEnd / resumesAt
props.description: – · The billing period (the ring and the renew or end date) and, when paused, when billing resumes.

props.name: usage
props.description: – · { id, label, used, limit, unit? } meters.

props.name: card / invoices
props.description: – · { brand, last4, expMonth, expYear } and { id, date, amount, status, url? }; the latest three invoices show.

props.name: onPause / onCancel / onResume
props.description: – · Change the subscription; throw an Error to show its message. Without onPause, Cancel plan goes straight to the reasons.

props.name: onUpdateCard / onChangePlan
props.description: – · Open your portal for the card, and go to your plans.

props.name: pauseMonths / reasons
props.description: [1, 2, 3] / five common reasons · The pause lengths offered and the reasons to pick from.

useCases.title: Billing settings
useCases.description: The plan, usage, card and invoices on a SaaS account’s billing page.

useCases.title: Cancel flows
useCases.description: A pause offered before cancelling, with the reason kept for you.

useCases.title: Dunning
useCases.description: A failed payment shown on the plan with a way to update the card.

useCases.title: Memberships
useCases.description: A gym, course or community membership people can pause.

features.title: Where the period stands
features.description: A ring fills from periodStart to periodEnd with the days left inside; the status says when it renews, pauses or ends.

features.title: Usage that warns
features.description: Each meter rolls its count and turns amber from 90% of the limit.

features.title: Card and invoices
features.description: The card on file with Update (your portal) and the latest invoices with their status and a download.

features.title: A pause before the cancel
features.description: Cancel plan offers one to three months’ pause with the date billing resumes; onPause gets the months.

features.title: A reason you can use
features.description: Cancelling asks why (your reasons) with an optional note; onCancel gets both.

features.title: Undo in place
features.description: Paused or ending plans offer Resume now or Keep my plan through onResume.

states.title: active
states.description: The lit plan card (name, seats, price, a ring with the days left and “Renews Nov 8”), then usage meters, the card on file, three invoices, Change plan and Cancel plan.

states.title: usage
states.description: Meters fill from zero on mount (900ms); a meter at 90% or more turns amber with its count in full weight.

states.title: pause offer
states.description: Cancel plan turns the lower half to “Pause instead?” in 460ms; the month choice is a segmented control and “Billing resumes on …” morphs with it.

states.title: cancel
states.description: “No, cancel it” turns to the reasons (radio chips) and a note; Cancel subscription goes Cancelling → Cancelled, then the card says Ends and loses some colour.

states.title: paused
states.description: The status reads Paused until with the date, the ring is full and dimmed, and Resume now replaces Change plan.

states.title: past due
states.description: Payment failed in amber on the card, the failed invoice marked, and Update on the card opens your portal.
